stages.title: Flow Inventory
stages.objective: Resolve the current product journeys, entry points, exits, exceptional paths, and orphaned or dead-end screen responsibilities from canonical Figma plus the provider-resolved Module state.

stages.title: Screen Integration
stages.objective: Reconcile existing canonical screens into coherent product flows without redesigning business behavior or creating duplicate canonical surfaces.

stages.title: Interaction Wiring
stages.objective: Wire canonical navigation and prototype reactions for documented actions including forward, back, cancel, submit, retry, tabs, overlays, and other existing interaction responsibilities.

stages.title: State Coverage
stages.objective: Ensure observable default, loading, empty, validation, failure, disabled, success, and other required states exist only where supported by canonical Module state.

stages.title: Cross-Module Integration
stages.objective: Verify and materialize documented handoffs across Module boundaries while preserving domain ownership and avoiding duplicated workflows.

stages.title: Responsive Integration
stages.objective: Reconcile responsive behavior across complete journeys so navigation, density, overlays, tables, forms, and primary actions remain coherent between desktop and mobile.

stages.title: Prototype Validation
stages.objective: Run a fresh independent product-level review over happy paths, failure paths, backtracking, state transitions, cross-Module continuity, and responsive continuity.

stages.title: Integration Handoff
stages.objective: Persist execution evidence for the resolved checkpoint, stage plan, verification result, and any terminal gap without creating a second canonical product specification.
